name: Lead forms
description: Public forms that create contacts and deals

page.title: Lead forms
page.description: Publish forms on your website (iframe or script) or share the link. Each submission creates or reuses a contact and, when configured, opens a deal.
page.emptyDescription: Create a form, pick the fields and copy the code to your website.

delete.title: Delete form?
delete.description: The form "{{name}}" stops working wherever it is published and its submission history is erased. Contacts and deals already created stay in the CRM.

rotate.title: Generate a new public address?
rotate.description: The current codes and links of "{{name}}" stop working at once. You will need to update the code on the websites that use it.

editor.description: Define the fields, where each answer goes and what happens after the submission.
editor.name: Name
editor.actingUserHelp: Contacts and deals are created with this user's permissions and owned by them, unless the form sets an owner or a distribution rule. If they lose access, submissions fail and show up in the history.
editor.fieldsHelp: Each field can go to a contact field (system or custom). A required field must go to the contact name.
editor.label: Label
editor.fullNameTarget: Full name (splits first and last name)
editor.optionsHelp: One per line. Use "value | label" when the stored value differs from the displayed text.
editor.dedupe: Reuse the contact when the email already exists
editor.createDeal: Create a deal linked to the contact
editor.titleTemplateHelp: Use the field identifier in double braces, like {{field}}, to insert answers and {{form}} for the form name.
editor.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line. When filled, only these websites can show the form in an iframe and submit through the script. Spam is blocked by a honeypot field and rate limits.
editor.ownerActingUser: The user who creates the records
editor.ownerHelp: With a distribution rule, each submission picks the rule's next owner; if nobody is available, the fixed owner (or the user who creates the records) is used. Existing contacts keep their current owner.

preview.title: Preview
preview.label: Form preview
preview.defaultSuccess: Thank you! We received your details.

snippets.title: Embed "{{name}}"
snippets.description: Choose how to publish the form on your website.
snippets.inactive: The form is inactive: the codes below only work after you activate it.
snippets.iframeHelp: Ready-made page isolated from the rest of the website. Works even without JavaScript.
snippets.scriptHelp: Renders the form inside the page, inheriting the website font. Paste it where the form should appear.
snippets.linkHelp: Share it on social networks, email or a QR code.

submissions.title: Submissions of "{{name}}"
submissions.description: Submission history, including those flagged as spam and those that failed.
submissions.emptyDescription: Submissions show up here as soon as the form is used.

errors.key: Use lowercase letters, digits or _ starting with a letter (up to 40)
errors.nameFieldRequired: The contact name field must be required
errors.duplicateTarget: Two fields save to the same contact field
errors.nameMappingRequired: A field must save to the contact first name (or full name)
errors.amount: Use a number with up to 2 decimal places
errors.url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
errors.origin: Use only the website address, like https://www.example.com

submission.lead_form_owner_unavailable: The user who creates the records lost access
submission.lead_form_tag_failed: The tag could not be applied
submission.lead_form_deal_failed: The deal could not be created
